description: This is a modern white pendant light featuring a spherical shade composed of numerous overlapping, irregularly shaped flat discs, giving it a unique textured and sculptural appearance. The light hangs from the ceiling by multiple thin suspension wires connected to a circular canopy. A separate, smaller circular component on a short stem is also visible, likely an additional part of the lighting system or a mounting element. The design is clean and contemporary, making it both a functional light source and a striking decorative piece.
